description_en: Invokes UpdateUser to modify the information of a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
kebab_example: aliyun ims update-user --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --user-id 207329002493920000 --new-user-principal-name new@example.onaliyun.com --new-display-name new --new-mobile-phone 86-18688880000 --new-email alice@example.com --new-comments This_is_a_cloud_computing_engineer. --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateUser

parameters.help_en:
The logon name of the specified Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

You must specify either the `UserPrincipalName` or `UserId` parameter, but not both
parameters.help_zh:
指定的RAM用户登录名称。

`UserPrincipalName`与`UserId`参数，必须指定一个，但不能同时指定
parameters.name: user_principal_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the specified Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
You must specify either the `UserPrincipalName` or `UserId` parameter, but not both
parameters.help_zh:
指定的RAM用户ID。
`UserPrincipalName`与`UserId`参数，必须指定一个，但不能同时指定
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The new logon name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

The format is `<username>@<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com`, where `<username>` is the RAM username and `<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com` is the default domain name.

The `UserPrincipalName` must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The `<username>` must be 1 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的新登录名称。

格式为`<username>@<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com`，其中`<username>`为RAM用户名称，`<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com`为默认域名。

`UserPrincipalName`长度为`1~128`个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。其中`<username>`的长度为`1~64`个字符
parameters.name: new_user_principal_name

parameters.help_en:
The new display name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

The name must be 1 to 24 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的新显示名称。

长度为1~24个字符
parameters.name: new_display_name

parameters.help_en:
The new mobile phone number of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

Format: area code-phone number.

This parameter is applicable only to China site (aliyun.com)
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的新手机号码。

格式：国际区号-号码。

该参数仅适用于中国站
parameters.name: new_mobile_phone

parameters.help_en:
The new email address of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

This parameter is applicable only to China site (aliyun.com)
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的新电子邮箱。

该参数仅适用于中国站
parameters.name: new_email

parameters.example: This is a cloud computing engineer.
parameters.help_en:
The new comments.

The comments must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
新备注。

长度为1~128个字符
parameters.name: new_comments
